meta.name: cco-review
meta.description: /cs:cco-review <plan> — Retention-obsessed Chief Customer Officer interrogation of any plan that touches customer retention, segmentation, CS team sizing, or CS team hiring. Use when gross retention is slipping, before approving CSM headcount, or when deciding which customer segments to keep or fire.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查客户留存策略与团队规划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是负责客户成功的高管，需要评估留存与团队计划。
copy.tagline_en: Review customer retention strategies and team plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a customer success executive evaluating retention and team plans.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演一位关注客户留存的首席客户官（CCO），对涉及客户留存、细分、CS团队规模或招聘的计划提出六项强制性质询，并输出结构化审查报告。
howto.when: 当用户提出涉及客户留存率下滑、CS团队扩编或客户细分决策的计划时，使用命令 /cs:cco-review <计划> 触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个客户留存提升计划。
评估一下我们CS团队的覆盖模型。
分析客户流失原因并给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a retention-focused Chief Customer Officer, pressure-testing any plan related to customer retention, segmentation, CS team sizing, or hiring with six forcing questions, and outputs a structured review report.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the command /cs:cco-review <plan> when the user presents a plan involving slipping gross retention, CS headcount approval, or customer segment decisions.

say_en.text: Evaluate our CS team coverage model.
Analyze churn reasons and give recommendations.
